newsitem.title: ESTONIA: BOURSE CLOSE:INDEX SETS NEW RECORD, BANKS RISE.
newsitem.headline: BOURSE CLOSE:INDEX SETS NEW RECORD, BANKS RISE.

text.p: * Preliminary closing data show bourse turnover at 138
million kroons compared to 46 million kroons.
* Index gains 2.05 percent to new record 350.87.
* Hansapank turns over 45.6 million kroons to gain
* Hoiupank the biggest gainer, adding 4.20 kroons
to close at 204 kroons on turnover of 19.8 million kroons.
* Forekspank gains six kroons to 222.50 kroons in
* On the free market, Norma turns over 4.3 million
kroons to close at 89.50, 1.50 kroons higher.
